pages.text: These illagers are your officers and elite, born to war and trained without the $(l:rumors/requiem_demolition_scroll)Demolition Scroll$(). At a single word they will form up, march, and charge for you.

The Company Captain is the soul of the whole company. He draws scattered illagers into formation and makes them march, turn, and wheel as one. With an $(l:crafts/requiem_assault_order)Assault Order$() in hand he will approach, scout, bombard, and storm an objective on his own — no need for you to set foot on the field.
The Drummer beats the snare drum, driving a rhythm into the company. Where the drum sounds, boots fall in step and enemy nerve frays.
The Cavalry Captain leads a cavalry squad, banner held high. Bind him with the Cavalry Standard to order a charge or rally; light cavalry can also be bound to him with a wand.
Light Cavalry are mounted skirmishers who cut down foes in a charge and loose arrows on the move when rallied — swift as the wind.
The Apothecary is a field medic who purges negative effects from allied servants, and can be attached to the company on campaign.
